key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9C9C
name: or_masks_into_strided_table_gated
description: Decrements a counter and, while it stays positive, ORs four 16-bit values held in globals into strided offsets of a shared table. A second branch repeats the same pattern at different strides.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D52
name: or_masks_into_strided_table
description: Repeats the strided OR of four 16-bit values into a shared table, without the counter gate of the sibling routine. It also writes one extra word in the last block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D9C
name: select_and_copy_title_string
description: Looks up a table entry from a flag word and copies a zero-terminated title string into a buffer, or falls back to a fixed value when no entry matches. Its compares against hunk type codes show it is part of the executable loading path.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9DF2
name: lookup_entry_flags_and_copy
description: Looks up a table entry and sets a pointer and a copy length from it, then runs the same byte copy as its sibling. It checks a stored status word and falls into a shared OR-into-table block when the copy is done.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E3A
name: probe_table_for_flagged_entry
description: Probes up to ten table entries by index and stops at the first entry whose flag bit 1 is set. It then records a length and a source pointer for a zero-terminated copy.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E42
name: scan_entries_and_copy_patrol_text
description: Scans table entries for a flag bit, then copies a fixed zero-terminated status string into a buffer. The copy text is the phrase for a unit on patrol, and the routine resets its state when no entry matches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9EB4
name: or_block_rows_enable_dma
description: Computes a table offset from a timing value, ORs four words of a block into strided rows of a shared buffer, and writes the DMA control register with the set bit to enable channels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9F5A
name: flush_pending_or_rows
description: Clears a pending flag and, when a second flag is negative, runs a block of stored register writes and an OR-into-table loop with a counter. The routine matches the pattern of its neighbours in this module.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A04E
name: conditionally_clear_or_rows
description: Clears a state word when a counter is non-zero and then runs the same OR-into-table pattern over stored values. Its structure matches the neighbouring routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A100
name: conditionally_clear_or_rows_alt
description: Runs the same conditional clear and OR-into-table sequence as its neighbour, with a different table offset for the stored values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E0
name: copy_three_words_and_or_rows
description: Copies three 16-bit words from one set of globals to another, conditionally calls a helper when two words differ, then ORs values into strided rows of a shared table while a counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E4
name: copy_three_words_then_or_rows
description: Copies three words between globals, calls a helper when they differ, and then runs the same strided OR-into-table pattern. It is a longer variant of its neighbour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A2B6
name: setup_sprite_slot_with_height_offset
description: Computes a slot offset from a value, writes a pair of sprite control words into a buffer, and stores the buffer address in the sprite pointer registers. A height-dependent adjustment is added when the slot index is above a threshold.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A3A2
name: fill_secondary_sprite_slot
description: Computes a second sprite slot offset from an input value, writes its control words and saved pointers, and copies several coordinate words into the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A46C
name: clear_two_pointer_slots
description: Writes zero into two pointer slots referenced through a base register and returns. It has no branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A47C
name: copy_pointers_when_flag_set
description: Copies two stored pointer values from one block into another when a flag word is non-zero. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A492
name: call_two_routines_save_word
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and then saves a data register value into a global word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A4CA
name: copy_sprite_block_words
description: Copies six 32-bit words from a block at fixed offsets into globals. The block contains the sprite pointer words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A50C
name: copy_five_sprite_block_words
description: Copies five 32-bit words and one further word from a block at fixed offsets into globals, matching the sprite pointer layout of its neighbour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A54E
name: setup_sprite_slot_from_table
description: Builds a sprite control slot from an input value and a table entry, writes the pointer words and stores the slot address for later use. It has a branch for values outside a fixed range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A55A
name: copy_sprite_pointer_word_block
description: Copies a 32-bit word from a state block into globals and repeats the copy for the remaining slots of the sprite pointer block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A58C
name: copy_four_sprite_block_words
description: Copies four 32-bit words and one further word from a state block into globals, matching the sprite pointer layout used by its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A606
name: scan_objects_within_range
description: Loops over fixed table entries and compares scaled coordinate differences against a plus-or-minus window, merging a constant into a register for each hit. It also includes a text reference to a status label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A870
name: load_eight_colour_registers_on_countdown
description: Counts down a timer and, while it is non-zero, calls a stored hook and returns. When the count reaches zero it copies eight words from a table into the colour registers of the custom chip.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A878
name: countdown_then_copy_colour_block
description: Decrements a countdown shared with its neighbour, calls a stored hook while it runs, and copies a block of colour words into the colour registers once it expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A912
name: test_point_within_bounds
description: Subtracts a reference position from several coordinates and tests the results against a plus-or-minus window, returning a flag that says whether the point lies inside the window.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A94A
name: check_coordinate_window_and_update
description: Checks several coordinate differences against window limits and, when they pass, updates a state word and calls two helpers. The routine does a sequence of signed comparisons.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AB20
name: initialise_flight_state_defaults
description: Clears a set of globals and writes default text digits into the message buffer, then sets some values when a particular status bit is set. It also primes a count and a set of table pointers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AC72
name: update_status_message_text
description: Computes a bank value from a control register and writes a status line of text such as brakes and landing gear, with extra conditional adjustments. It is a large routine that drives the on-screen status display.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BDCE
name: sync_two_bit_state_fields
description: Extracts two-bit fields from two state bytes, compares them with stored values and writes a fixed control value when a field has changed. It returns early when a pointer check fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEBE
name: interpolate_table_by_angle
description: Saves three state words, wraps a 16-bit angle around its half-turn and linearly interpolates a value between two adjacent table entries using the low five bits as the fraction.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEC2
name: interpolate_table_angle_extended
description: Performs the same angle-wrapped table interpolation as its neighbour, then runs a longer sequence of stored updates and calls a helper that merges a constant into the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1B0
name: interpolate_three_table_values
description: Interpolates three values from two tables at coordinate-derived indices, using the low five bits as the blend fraction. The results are stored back as 16-bit words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1B8
name: interpolate_table_fragment_b
description: Fragment of the interpolation sequence in the same module. It performs the blend between adjacent table entries for one coordinate and is entered mid-sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1CC
name: interpolate_table_fragment_c
description: Fragment of the table-blend sequence that performs the same table lookups and linear blend for a second coordinate. It is entered from a neighbouring routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1E0
name: interpolate_table_fragment_d
description: Single-entry fragment of the blend sequence: it begins the fixed-point interpolation between adjacent entries. Its work is completed by the routine that calls it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1E8
name: interpolate_table_fragment_e
description: Single-entry fragment of the table blend that starts the interpolation for one coordinate. The remaining steps run in the calling routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1EC
name: interpolate_table_fragment_f
description: Single-entry fragment of the table blend that starts the interpolation for the second coordinate. It is one of several entry points into the blend sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1F0
name: interpolate_table_full_frame
description: Runs the table blend over two coordinates, merges a constant into its result and stores the interpolated words in fixed-point form. It is a longer version of the blend sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C3CE
name: multiply_two_by_two_matrix_words
description: Multiplies two pairs of coefficients by stored scale values, sums the products and stores four 16-bit results. The arithmetic is a two-by-two fixed-point matrix multiply.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C512
name: multiply_matrix_pair_words
description: Multiplies pairs of coefficient words by stored scale values, sums the products into two fixed-point results and stores them as 16-bit words. It calls a helper that merges a constant.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C656
name: combine_scaled_coefficients_store
description: Scales two coefficient words, combines them with a second pair of table values and stores the results as packed words. A helper merges a constant into the output.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C79A
name: divide_fixed_point_by_restoring
description: Divides a signed fixed-point value by repeated trial subtraction over eight steps. It returns the quotient in the upper word and the remainder in the lower word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C7C4
name: divide_signed_fixed_point
description: Performs signed fixed-point division of a 32-bit numerator by a 16-bit divisor, handling the negative-minimum and sign cases before the unsigned division.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C820
name: complement_from_quarter_turn
description: Returns a constant quarter-turn value minus the result of its helper routine. It is a short wrapper that adjusts an angle-like value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C82C
name: search_table_for_angle_index
description: Takes an absolute value and scans a table for the first entry above it, then returns the index shifted into a fixed-point form with the original sign restored.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C862
name: update_landing_status_flags
description: Sets speed and attitude limits from status bits and computes coordinate differences against stored positions. It also drives status messages such as ready for takeoff, safe landing and weapons replenished.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0CE
name: prepare_scale_values_from_angle
description: Sets a flag bit in a byte, calls six helpers and then derives scaled values from a 360-degree-style multiplier and an offset table. It prepares values for the routine that follows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0F2
name: draw_weapon_status_with_blitter
description: Updates the weapon and target status text and waits for the blitter to finish before programming blit registers. It displays messages such as missile lock, primary, secondary and no target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D82A
name: wait_for_blitter_then_start_copy
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its destination pointer, modulo and size registers, and starts a blit with a fixed control word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA0E
name: start_masked_blit_after_idle
description: Sets a bit in a hardware-facing word, then when a flag is clear waits for the blitter to finish and programs its pointers, modulo and size before starting a blit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA2C
name: blit_display_rows_sequence
description: Waits for the blitter and then issues a sequence of blits for rows whose positions come from stored coordinates. It calls sixteen helpers and includes a text reference to a row label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DEF2
name: copy_rows_inside_window
description: Checks that a coordinate pair lies inside a fixed window, then copies six byte rows from a source into a destination, looking up row addresses from a table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DFB0
name: compute_scaled_screen_offset
description: Scales two coordinate differences by stored factors, subtracts them, and adds a constant offset to return a screen-space value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E00C
name: start_blit_with_fixed_setup
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its pointers, modulo and size registers, and starts a blit with a fixed control word. It returns a byte value unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E068
name: start_blit_line_variant
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its destination pointer, modulo, control and size registers, and starts a blit of a shorter, fixed width.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0A6
name: distance_table_fragment_a
description: Fragment that computes absolute coordinate differences, orders them as a larger and smaller value, and looks up a table entry from the combined result. It is a single-instruction entry into a longer distance routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0AA
name: distance_table_fragment_b
description: Fragment of the same distance computation: it orders two absolute differences and combines them through a table lookup. It shares its body with its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0AE
name: distance_table_fragment_c
description: Fragment that computes absolute coordinate differences and looks up a distance table entry from their larger and smaller values. It is a single-instruction entry point.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0B2
name: distance_table_fragment_d
description: Fragment of the octant distance computation: it adds the larger and smaller absolute differences and looks up the result in a table. It is one of several entries into the sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0BC
name: compute_distance_table_entry
description: Computes absolute coordinate differences, orders them as larger and smaller values, and derives a table index from their combination. It then looks up and stores the entry for later use.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E16A
name: draw_flagged_entries_with_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter, then loops over table entries whose flag bit is set and non-zero length, calling helpers for each one. It issues the drawing work for every matching entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E21E
name: start_blit_from_stored_pointer
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its destination pointer from a stored value, its modulo and size registers and a fixed control word, then starts the blit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E276
name: start_blit_swapped_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter and starts a blit like its neighbour, but programs the source and destination pointers in the opposite order.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3CE
name: projected_cell_address_fragment_a
description: Shifts two coordinate differences by a stored amount, offsets them to a screen position and returns a table address. It is a one-instruction entry into the projection code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3D2
name: projected_cell_address_fragment_b
description: Fragment of the screen-position projection that shifts coordinate differences and offsets them into a cell address. It falls through to the same table lookup as its neighbours.
